verdict.rationale: The full engine source is public on GitHub and can be cloned directly (git clone of mrdoob/three.js). A runtime probe of the npm registry independently confirms the MIT license, which permits reading, modifying and redistributing the engine. Public release notes showing source-level changes (e.g., Renderer.resetState) further confirm the code is open and actively maintained. Missing for 10: documented build-from-source or patch/fork workflow evidence, i.e. instructions or hands-on reports of modifying and rebuilding the engine.
